jobs.title: Product Manager, Recruit to Retire
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:  182202

Job Level:  Mid Level

Home District/Group:  DHO Information Technology Group

Department:  Technology Group

Market:  Corporate Home Office

Employment Type:  Full Time

Position Overview

Kiewit Technology Group (KTG) is seeking a Product Manager – Recruit to Retire to help shape and advance the technology platforms that support Kiewit employees throughout the employee lifecycle.

As part of the Payroll, Benefits & HXM Product Team, you will be responsible for several products across areas such as payroll, benefits, recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, and human experience management. You will serve as a key connection point between business stakeholders, users, and technology teams—turning business needs and opportunities into clear product priorities and executable solutions.

This role combines product strategy with hands-on execution . You will help establish product vision and roadmaps, manage and prioritize backlogs, define requirements, evaluate solutions, and guide features from idea through delivery and adoption. Success requires an ability to understand the big picture while working through the details necessary to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

The Product Manager reports to the Recruit to Retire Portfolio Manager, does not have any direct reports and works closely with Kiewit Technology Group (KTG), Kiewit Data Services (KDS), Delivery, Integrations, Architecture, project and field teams, and Home Office departments to create connected, consistent employee experiences across the enterprise.

District Overview

Kiewit Technology Group delivers technology solutions that help Kiewit improve project certainty, operational efficiency, and business performance. By connecting technology, data, processes, and people across field and Home Office operations, KTG enables better decision-making, smarter resource utilization, and continued innovation across the organization.

Location

This position is a full time in office role based on our LaVista, NE campus. The role requires regular and reliable attendance, professional communication and collaboration within team environments, and occasional evening or weekend availability based on business or implementation needs.

Responsibilities

- Own your product space. Serve as a subject matter expert and primary product contact for assigned solutions within the Recruit to Retire portfolio, including payroll, benefits, and HR/HXM products.

- Shape product strategy. Partner with product teams and stakeholders to define product vision, strategic direction, growth opportunities, lifecycle plans, and long-term technology roadmaps.

- Represent the customer. Develop a deep understanding of stakeholder and user needs and ensure their perspectives are represented throughout product planning and delivery.

- Turn needs into solutions. Identify business problems and opportunities, evaluate potential solutions, and translate requirements into clear features, user stories, and actionable work.

- Guide work from idea to delivery. Manage product ideation and intake, refine features and stories, support estimation and planning, and validate completed work against agreed-upon outcomes.

- Use data to drive decisions. Leverage data and analytics to identify business challenges, evaluate opportunities, measure success, and inform product priorities.

- Build alignment. Facilitate productive conversations across business and technology teams, navigate competing priorities, and build consensus around decisions and direction.

- Partner across technology. Work closely with Delivery, Integrations, Architecture, Data Services, and other product teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture and broader portfolio strategy.

- Manage expectations and commitments. Establish clarity around priorities, scope, timing, dependencies, and tradeoffs while ensuring stakeholders understand what is being delivered and why.

- Communicate with impact. Provide clear, concise updates on product progress, decisions, dependencies, risks, and opportunities to stakeholders and leaders at all levels.

- Champion strong product practices. Apply modern product management, project delivery, governance, and quality practices to continuously improve how products are planned, delivered, and supported.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of relevant experience working with SAP and/or SAP SuccessFactors, with experience across several employee lifecycle areas such as payroll, benefits, recruiting, onboarding, offboarding.

- Demonstrated experience working as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or in a comparable product leadership role within a complex technology environment.

- Strong understanding of product management practices, including product strategy, roadmap development, backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, and delivery.

- Ability to translate complex business needs into clear requirements and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to navigate difficult conversations and competing priorities.

- Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to identify dependencies, evaluate tradeoffs, anticipate risks, and drive issues toward resolution.

- Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities while maintaining focus on quality and business outcomes.

- A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with the ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity.

- Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective partnerships across business and technology teams.

- Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in construction, engineering, or related industries.

- Product management or product ownership experience in a large, technology-driven organization.

- Experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP SuccessFactors.

- Experience supporting enterprise HR, payroll, benefits, or employee-experience platforms. #LI-AK1

Other Requirements:

- Regular, reliable attendance

- Work productively and meet deadlines timely

- Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment.

- Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.

- Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.

- May work at various different locations and conditions may vary.

We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

​

jobs.title: Product Manager, Kiewit Fire Sprinkler
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:  182019

Job Level:  Mid Level

Home District/Group:  DHO Information Technology Group

Department:  Technology Group

Market:  Corporate Home Office

Employment Type:  Full Time

Position Overview

The Product Manager – Kiewit Fire Sprinkler is responsible for defining product vision, strategy, roadmap, and business value delivery for Kiewit’s subsidary Continental Fire Alarm and Sprinkler. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, users, and technology teams to ensure products align with operational objectives, improve efficiency, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

District Overview

Kiewit Technology Group builds solutions to enable and support our company's expansive operations. Our mission is to deliver project schedule and cost certainty by employing technology designed by and for the construction industry. Our team utilizes systems and tools that manage every part of Kiewit's business and the project lifecycle to improve planning and day-to-day execution in the field. We give our people real-time data to make faster, smarter decisions.

Location

This is a full time in office role located on our LaVista, NE campus or in our Phoenix, AZ office. We are not offering relocation for this role. This role also requires travel up to 25% of the time.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

· Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Kiewit Fire Sprinkler platforms and related technology solutions.

· Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, user experience, and business performance through technology and data-driven solutions.

· Partner with business leaders and technology teams to establish long-term product, technology, and lifecycle strategies.

· Develop and maintain business cases that support investment decisions and product enhancements that maximize business value

· Support budgeting, forecasting, and estimating for product initiatives.

Product Ownership & Backlog Management

· Oversee idea intake processes and evaluate opportunities based on business value, strategic alignment, and operational impact.

· Define business requirements and acceptance criteria that enable successful execution by development and support teams.

· Review completed work, validate business outcomes, and demonstrate product functionality to stakeholders.

Business Partnership & Support

· Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for Kiewit Fire Sprinkler platforms, associated business processes, and supporting data.

· Partner with stakeholders across KTG, KDS, and business operations to identify valuable opportunities and participate in the creation of a technology strategy.

· Provide guidance and support for the creation of a business focused technology and data strategy for your business areas of focus.

· Translate business needs into actionable requirements and communicate priorities to technical teams.

· Oversee data requirements and integration needs across applications, middleware platforms, enterprise systems, and IoT-enabled solutions.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

· Build strong relationships with users, business leaders, and technology partners.

· Facilitate collaboration among stakeholders with competing priorities.

· Effectively communicate product vision, priorities, progress, risks, and business value to all levels of the organization.

· Lead development of end-user training methods/plans, adoption strategies, and product communications.

· Act as the voice of the customer and advocate for user needs throughout the product lifecycle.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

· Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

· Be a champion for proper knowledge transfer across business and technical teams.

· Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve reliability, adoption, and customer satisfaction.

· Promote safe work practices and ensure compliance with organizational policies and operational standards.

Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

· Proven experience managing products, business systems, technology initiatives, or operational platforms.

· Experience with data analytics, middleware technologies, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, and data visualization tools.

· Skilled in negotiation, conflict resolution, and handling high-visibility or escalated issues.

· Self-motivated, adaptable, and effective in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

· Ability and willingness to travel a minimum of 25%.

· Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license. #LI-AK1

Other Requirements:

- Regular, reliable attendance

- Work productively and meet deadlines timely

- Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment.

- Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.

- Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.

- May work at various different locations and conditions may vary.

We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Product Manager, ServiceNow
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:  182075

Job Level:  Mid Level

Home District/Group:  DHO Information Technology Group

Department:  Technology Group

Market:  Corporate Home Office

Employment Type:  Full Time

Position Overview

The Senior Platform Innovation Lead is responsible for driving the strategic evolution of the ServiceNow platform by identifying, validating, and operationalizing advanced capabilities that deliver measurable business value. This role focuses on translating emerging technologies—including AI, automation, predictive intelligence, integrations, and analytics—into practical, scalable solutions with clear outcomes.

Operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and value realization, this role ensures innovation efforts move beyond exploration into adoption and measurable impact. The position partners closely with product, architecture, engineering, and operations teams to embed innovation into the core platform roadmap and delivery model.

This role is distinct in that it:

-
Focuses on what is possible and valuable, rather than how solutions are built

-
Prioritizes future capabilities and strategic evolution, not current demand execution

-
Emphasizes use cases, outcomes, and adoption, not technical implementation

Success requires disciplined focus on:

-
Value over novelty

-
Adoption over experimentation

-
Outcomes over activity

District Overview

Kiewit Technology Group builds solutions to enable and support our company's expansive operations. Our mission is to deliver project schedule and cost certainty by employing technology designed by and for the construction industry. Our team utilizes systems and tools that manage every part of Kiewit's business and the project lifecycle to improve planning and day-to-day execution in the field. We give our people real-time data to make faster, smarter decisions.

Location

This is a full time in office role located on our LaVista, NE campus.

Responsibilities

The Senior Platform Innovation Lead drives the strategic evolution of the ServiceNow platform by identifying, validating, and operationalizing advanced capabilities that deliver measurable business value. The role translates emerging technologies—AI, automation, predictive intelligence, integrations, and analytics—into practical, scalable solutions with clear outcomes. Operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and value realization, this position ensures innovation moves beyond exploration into adoption and impact. The role partners with product, architecture, engineering, and operations to embed innovation into the platform roadmap.

1. Innovation Strategy & Roadmap

-
Define and maintain a ServiceNow innovation roadmap aligned with enterprise strategy

-
Identify and prioritize high‑value opportunities across AI/GenAI, predictive intelligence, workflow automation, and analytics

-
Ensure initiatives align with business priorities and platform direction

-
Partner with Product and Architecture to integrate innovation into the core roadmap

2. AI, Automation & Advanced Capabilities

-
Evaluate and operationalize AI‑driven workflows, predictive models, and machine‑learning use cases

-
Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve decision‑making, and enhance user experience

-
Ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and widely adopted

3. Use Case Development & Value Engineering

-
Define high‑impact use cases tied to measurable outcomes

-
Build business cases and ROI models to support prioritization

-
Evaluate initiatives based on value potential, feasibility, and adoption likelihood

-
Ensure all innovation efforts have clear value hypotheses and measurable results

4. Integration & Ecosystem Strategy

-
Identify and drive strategic integrations (ERP, HRIS, security platforms)

-
Partner with Architecture to define scalable integration patterns

-
Ensure integrations support enterprise strategy and long‑term sustainability

5. Experimentation, Pilots & Scaling

-
Lead pilot programs and proofs of concept

-
Validate business value, user adoption, and technical feasibility

-
Transition successful pilots into the product backlog or standardized capabilities

-
Ensure efficient movement from concept to production

6. Governance & Responsible Innovation

-
Establish responsible innovation practices, especially for AI and automation

-
Ensure alignment with architecture standards, security, and data privacy

-
Define guardrails for AI usage and automation decision‑making

-
Balance innovation speed with risk management

7. Cross‑Functional Leadership & Influence

-
Collaborate across platform roles to ensure successful adoption

-
Feed validated opportunities into Product Management

-
Partner with Architecture for feasibility and alignment

-
Guide Engineering on emerging patterns

-
Enable Customer Success/Business Analysis to drive adoption

-
Align with Operations for stable rollout

Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience

-
3+ years of hands‑on experience with ServiceNow operations and systems administration , including recent work within the past 4 years

-
Strong knowledge of the ServiceNow platform , modules, and ecosystem

-
Experience with AI and machine‑learning concepts (practical application, not data‑science depth)

-
Background in automation strategy , workflow optimization, and enterprise integrations

-
Ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business value

-
Skilled in developing business cases , ROI models, and value‑realization frameworks

-
Proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority

-
Strong strategic thinking paired with an execution‑focused mindset

-
Excellent communication skills across both technical and business audiences

Success Criteria

Success in this role is measured by outcomes , not activity:

Business Value Realization

-
Demonstrated ROI from implemented innovations

-
Reduction in manual effort and operational cost

Adoption & Utilization

-
High adoption of new capabilities

-
Increased platform utilization across the enterprise

Operational Impact

-
Percentage of processes successfully automated

-
Improvements in cycle time, efficiency, and throughput

Innovation Effectiveness

-
Pilot solutions consistently transitioned into scalable production capabilities

-
Delivery of stable, non‑experimental, enterprise‑ready solutions #LI-AK1

Other Requirements:

- Regular, reliable attendance

- Work productively and meet deadlines timely

- Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment.

- Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.

- Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.

- May work at various different locations and conditions may vary.

We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
